class.name: VirtualTexturePageCache
class.brief_description: Sparse virtual texture page cache with feedback-driven requests, LRU physical page pool and an indirection image.
class.description: Page keys encode (mip, x, y) with [method pack_page]. The lowest (1-page) mip is pinned and always resident, so every virtual page can fall back to a resident ancestor. The physical atlas has slots of [code]page_size + 2 * border[/code] pixels; the page sits inside and the border is edge-replicated for bilinear filtering. [method indirection_image] has one texel per mip-0 page ([code]r, g[/code] = physical slot, [code]b[/code] = resident mip) for shader sampling. The design follows publicly documented sparse virtual texturing (Barrett, GDC 2008). This is a CPU page cache and is independent of [TextureStreaming], which streams texture mips.

method.name: pack_page
method.description: Packs a page into a key.

method.name: page_mip
method.description: Extracts the mip of a page key.

method.name: page_x
method.description: Extracts the page X of a page key.

method.name: page_y
method.description: Extracts the page Y of a page key.

method.name: get_virtual_size
method.description: Returns the virtual texture size in pixels.

method.name: get_page_size
method.description: Returns the page size in pixels.

method.name: get_border
method.description: Returns the page border in pixels.

method.name: get_physical_pages_x
method.description: Returns the physical atlas width in pages.

method.name: get_physical_pages_y
method.description: Returns the physical atlas height in pages.

method.name: get_pages_mip0
method.description: Returns the number of pages per axis at mip 0.

method.name: get_top_mip
method.description: Returns the lowest (pinned, 1-page) mip level.

method.name: get_stat_hits
method.description: Returns the number of feedback hits.

method.name: get_stat_misses
method.description: Returns the number of feedback misses.

method.name: get_stat_evictions
method.description: Returns the number of evicted pages.

method.name: setup
method.description: Configures the cache and pins the top mip.

method.name: pages_at
method.description: Returns the number of pages per axis at [param mip].

method.name: request_from_feedback
method.description: Processes feedback entries ([method pack_page] keys read back from the screen-space feedback pass). Duplicates are folded, resident pages are touched (LRU) and counted as hits.

method.name: update
method.description: Uploads pending pages (coarser mips first) into free or evicted slots and advances the frame. Pages needed this frame and the pinned top mip are never evicted. Returns the number of uploaded pages.

method.name: indirection_image
method.description: Returns the indirection image, rebuilt when dirty. Each texel resolves to the best resident mip.

method.name: physical_atlas
method.description: Returns the physical page atlas.

method.name: lookup
method.description: Resolves [param uv] at [param mip] to the nearest resident ancestor. Returns [code]{slot: Vector2i, resident_mip: int, page: Vector2i}[/code].

method.name: is_resident
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the page is resident.

method.name: resident_count
method.description: Returns the number of resident pages.

method.name: pending_count
method.description: Returns the number of pending page requests.

method.name: stats
method.description: Returns [code]hits[/code], [code]misses[/code], [code]evictions[/code] and [code]resident_pages[/code].

members.member: Callable [code]func(mip: int, page_x: int, page_y: int) -> Image[/code] returning the page content ([code]page_size[/code] square).
